title: Minutemen general on a base Mac
machine: Apple M3 MacBook Air, 16 GB, under Not Proton and CrossOver
summary: Lunar Fallout Overhaul, Sim Settlements 2 and the Minutemen, with the Brotherhood kept as an ally and no visual mods. Built for a steady 40-45 fps; on this Mac the full list falls to 20-30 fps outdoors.

title: Minutemen and Brotherhood, full immersion on a gaming PC
machine: Ryzen 7 9800X3D, RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB, 32 GB, 3440×1440 VRR, NixOS, Proton 11.0-2
summary: The Minutemen and settlements at the centre, the Brotherhood as a second career, an open ending. Adds Community Shaders and lighting, Lunar Fallout Arsenal and reload animations, living settlers and travelling NPCs, survival-lite needs and a few quests and companions. Installed and tested on 2026-11-07; the playthrough is in progress.
